title: DrHorticulture inference contract v1
description: POST /v1/analyze between the api and the inference service, sent with the header x-inference-key: <INFERENCE_API_KEY>. v1 was revised in place on 2026-10-01, before any inference service was live; once one is live, v1 is frozen and a breaking change becomes /v2/analyze with contracts/inference.v2.*.

image_url.description: Supabase signed URL, valid 5 minutes. The service downloads the image itself.

species_hint.description: Species the client sent (trimmed, lowercased), or null. A hint only.

AnalyzeResponse.description: 200 response body, inference -> api. Raw numbers only: the service never decides fertilize or abstain. The api treats a body that fails this schema as a failure and stores the full body in analyses.raw_response.

segmentation.description: CV stage: YOLO-seg canopy mask, with petals, pot, and soil masked out.

species.description: CV stage: top class of the pretrained species classifier.

features.description: CV stage: color indices (for example VARI, ExG, GLI, NGRDI) on masked canopy pixels. Any keys; numeric values with no range, since some indices are negative; may be empty.

estimate.description: ML stage: ensemble of regression heads on the embedding plus species probabilities.

ndvi.description: Mean of the ensemble heads. GreenSeeker ground truth is 0.00-0.99.

confidence.description: Derived from the ensemble spread by the service; the api never recomputes it.

calibration_card.description: Recorded only, not enforced. Optional: no CV function produces it yet.

ErrorResponse.description: Any 4xx/5xx body from the inference service, including 401 for a missing or wrong x-inference-key.
